Commentary.Commentary: Right then, there is a lot of time left in this Test. We are only halfway through and there is just an innings left. The ball is turning, bouncing but also keeping low. Bangladesh will feel they have a golden chance to win a Test against England and level the series 1-1. Expect lots of chatter, spin when England come out to bat. Do join us for in a while for England's chase.

Rashid finished with 4 for 52 but that was all that worked for England. They tried hard but came second best. Not to forget the drop catches and the fielding lapses. England will know they have their task cut out. Their top order has struggled on this tour so far and the home side will look to put them under further pressure.

That ends a fine effort from Bangladesh with the bat! In the first Test they had collapsed to let go of the advantage but this time they have corrected it and set England a stiff target of 273 runs on this pitch. Tamim and Kayes gave them a good start. Kayes carried on to score a vital 78. The middle order chipped in with handy cameos to ensure they have a par score on board.

OUT! ALL OUT! Shorter on middle and leg, going away, Rabbi looks to go big but ends up top edging it. Rashid gets under it and takes a simple catch to finish with a 4-fer. ENGLAND NEED 273 RUNS TO WIN!
Nice shot! Hom gets across and scoops it down to fine leg. Ballance dives in the deep towards the fence and keeps them to three.
On middle, played towards covers.
Outside off, Hom bottom edges his cut.
Floated on middle, Hom comes down and turns it to mid-wicket.
Fuller on middle, clipped through mid-wicket for a single.

CONFUSION! Fuller on middle, clipped through mid-wicket. They look for a single which they should not have. They end up in the middle going nowhere, Hom gets across in time to reach the striker's end.
Short outside off, punched off the back foot towards mid off.
Floated outside off, Rabbi comes forward and defends it.
This time Kamrul gets right forward and defends this.
SIX! What a shot! Floated outside off, Kamrul gets under it and clobbers it over mid-wicket for a maximum. He sends the chest guard back! LEAD IS 267!
MOEEN ALI into the attack now.
Looks to cut this one through but is beaten all ends up.
Shorter on middle, spins away, Hom pushes it towards covers.
Pulled through mid-wicket but another single refused.

FOUR LEG BYES! Bowls it on off, the ball hits the crack and spins down the leg side, Hom crouches low and lets it hit on his body. The ball runs down to the fine leg fence for a boundary. Leg bye signaled.
Drives it to long on but refuses the single.
Pulled through square leg but not for any runs.
Angled on a length on off, Rabbi defends it much to the delight of the crowd.
Tries to lure Rabbi into the drive with this one wide outside off, Rabbi resists the urge.
Slanted down the leg side, Rabbi lets it go.
On a length outside off, Hom comes down and slaps it towards extra cover. Mid off goes to his left and stops it in time.
FOUR! In the gap! Full toss from Stokes outside off, Hom reaches out for it and places it wide of covers for a boundary. Handy runs these!
Fuller outside off, slammed hard towards mid off.
KAMRUL ISLAM RABBI is the last man in.

OUT! RASHID STRIKES! Bowled on the stumps, Mehedi comes down swinging at it and is beaten in the air. The ball goes off the outside edge and flies to Joe Root at first slip who takes the catch. That went quickly to Root but he did well to catch that one.
Floated on off, turns away, keeps low, Mehedi plays at it and is beaten by the low bounce.
Goes back and pushes it towards point.
Stays on the back foot and defends it.
Hasan keeps it out from his crease.
Fuller on the stumps, played towards mid on for a single.
On a length outside off, Mehedi pushes at it and is beaten.

NOT OUT! Direct hit but no harms done! Good length outside off, Mehedi edges it towards the slip cordon. There is a direct hit from Duckett at backward point but Mehedi dives back in time after being sent back. The ricochet gets them a couple of runs.
Third umpire is referred for a run-out appeal at the striker's end.
Fuller outside off, Mehedi comes forward and pushes it to covers.
MEHEDI HASAN is the new man in.

OUT! Stokes strikes! Hurls it outside off, Taijul pushes at it tamely and edges it through to the keeper who dives to his left and takes the catch. Didn't take long for England to strike here. BANGLADESH LEAD BY 249!
On a length outside off, pushed towards covers.
FOUR! Good start for Taijul! Stokes hurls a gentle loosener on off, Islam drives it down the ground through mid on for a boundary.
Cook has a word with BEN STOKES who will bowl from the other end. A couple of slips in place for Taijul.
Landed on off, turns away, Hom stays back and defends it.
Short outside off, Hom cuts it to covers.
Floated outside off, swept down to fine leg for a single by Islam to get off the mark.

Welcome back for the second session of play. Bangladesh have three wickets left and will want to add as many as possible. SHUVAGATA HOM is joined by TAIJUL ISLAM at the crease. ADIL RASHID to continue! Here we go...
...DAY 3...SESSION 2...

England will know they have a lot of catch up to do and a daunting fourth innings chase awaits them. They will want to keep the hosts in check in the coming session and try and stay in the game. Bangladesh have a 244-run lead, how many will they target? Let's see. Do join us in a while for the second session.

England were awful in the session, dropping as many as four catches and Bairstow missed a couple of stumpings as well. Kayes was dropped twice before he was out lbw for 78. Shakib too was given a life along with Rahim. Shakib and Rahim departed in quick succession but not before taking the lead past 200. Hom and Sabbir threw their bats at everything despite lunch approaching and Rashid dismissed Sabbir just at the stroke of lunch.

What a session for Bangladesh! Despite the four wickets lost they have managed to score 116 runs. They have a lead of 244 runs already and as of now it looks more than enough on a surface which is not getting easier to bat on. Bangladesh will look to press on the advantage and bat England out of the game.

OUT! PLUMB! Quicker one on middle, Sabbir is on his back foot and fails to bring his bat down in time. That is plumb and the umpire raises his finger to rule it out. Sabbir walks back. Dharmasena has a word with Cook about the recent events. That's also LUNCH, DAY 3!
Fuller on middle, Hom comes down and heaves it towards mid on for a single.
Flatter on the pads, Hom cannot clip it through.
More drama! Slower one outside off, Sabbir is early into his shot and the ball lobs towards short cover. Stokes runs across to his left but cannot get to it. He continues to talk his way away.
S Ravi has had enough and has a word with Root to have a word with Ben Stokes.
Good length outside off, Sabbir pushes it to covers. Stokes continues his barrage of words.
Take that, Stokes! On a length outside off, Sabbir comes down and slaps it over mid on. The ball just dies down towards the fence as it came off the toe end of the bat. Two runs!
Good length on off, worked towards the on side for a single.
FOUR! Hom is frustrating England here! On a length outside off, Hom gets an outside edge down to third man for a boundary. That was deliberately played.
In the air but safe! On a length outside off, Sabbir goes for the drive on the up and gets it to deep point for a single.
Hom goes for a loose drive through covers but gets an inside edge.
Shorter one that bounces a lot, Hom rides the bounce and taps it towards covers.
FOUR! Another one to the fence! Floated on middle, Hom goes across the line and slog sweeps this through mid-wicket for a boundary. The runs are flowing in a hurry here.
Short outside off, cut towards covers.
FOUR! Swept away! Fuller on the pads, Hom gets down on it and sweeps it hard through square leg for a boundary.
Bowls the googly on middle, spins down, Hom fails to pull it through.
The umpires are having an animated chat with Cook, the England captain. There seems to have been some exchange between Stokes and Sabbir between the overs.

NOT OUT! Review wasted! On a length outside off, Sabbir looks to flirt with it. The ball deviates a touch as it flies to the keeper Bairstow who takes the catch and celebrates thinking that it is a regulation catch. Stokes cannot believe it is not given out. England go for the review and the replays show that there was no bat there, Cook is not impressed. They have lost both their reviews here.
ENGLAND look very confident. They take a review for a caught behind against Sabbir Rahman.
FOUR! In the gap! A touch short outside off, Sabbir gets on top of that one and place it wide of point for a boundary.
This one is down the leg side, Rahman lets it go.
FOUR! Drilled! Stokes goes for the yorker outside off, Sabbir drives it through extra covers for a boundary.
Sabbir walks down the wicket and defends it to covers. Stokes is surprised by that movement by Sabbir.
Flicks it through backward square leg for a single to get off the mark.
Floated on middle, Sabbir comes forward and defends it.
Short and spinning away, pushed towards covers by Sabbir.
FOUR! Off the mark! The customary short ball from leg spinner arrives and Sabbir camps back to pull it through mid-wicket for a boundary.
Stays in his crease and keeps it out.
Sabbir pushes it towards the on side.
Shorter on off, Sabbir stays back and defends it.
SHUVAGATA HOM walks in.

OUT! EASY AS YOU LIKE! Angled in on a length outside off, pitches and moves away a touch, Rahim plays away from the body and edges it to Cook at first slip who takes a good catch to his left. Bangladesh have now lost two in quick succession. LEAD BY 214, 4 WICKETS IN HAND!
On the pads, Rahim fails to clip it through. Mild appeal turned down.
Shorter outside off, Rahim gets on top and looks to cut but finds the fielder.
Places this one towards point but not in the gap.
Rahim defends it from his crease.
On a length outside off, Rahim comes forward and defends it.
Full toss that is played towards mid on by Sabbir.
SABBIR RAHMAN comes out to bat.

OUT! DRAGGED ON! Bowls it outside off, the ball spins in off the rough, Shakib stays back to cut that one but ends up dragging it onto his stumps. That is a big wicket for England but is it a bit too late? Bangladesh lead is 214 runs and they have five wickets in hand!
Flatter on middle, Shakib stays back and defends it.
Shakib gets back and defends it.
FOUR! Smacked! Floated outside off, Shakib throws his bat at it and gets it through covers for a boundary.
Too full on middle, Shakib drives it back down the wicket. Bairstow thinks it has come off the pads and is the lone man appealing.
ADIL RASHID comes into the attack. Expect Bangladesh to go after his bowling here.
Shorter in length on middle, Shakib pulls it through mid-wicket for a single.
Back of a length on middle, Shakib defends it off the inner half of the bat down the wicket.
Sprays it wide down the leg side, Shakib cannot clip it through.
This time Stokes clips it to square leg.
Too full on middle and leg, Shakib fails to clip it through. Muted appeal from Stokes for an lbw.
Rahim places it past point for a single.
Shorter outside off, Shakib comes down and pushes it to covers with his bat and pad together.
Flatter on middle, Shakib keeps it out.
Fuller outside off, Shakib comes forward and defends it back down the wicket.
Spins in sharply from outside off, Shakib stays back and chops it down to third man for a couple of runs.
Too full again, Shakib drives it towards mid on.
FOUR! The runs continue to flow! Fuller outside off, Shakib drills it through extra cover and beats Woakes from mid off and the sweeper cover for a boundary.
Back of a length outside off, Rahim pushes it to covers.
Rahim comes forward and pushes it to covers.
Outside off on a length, Rahim comes forward and defends it.
On a length on off, Rahim defends it off his crease.
Shakib guides it towards third man for a run.
EDGED! On a good length outside off, Rahim edges his push down to third man for a single.
BEN STOKES to bowl now.
Spins down the leg side, left alone by Shakib.
Shakib comes forward and defends it.
Shakib gets across and defends it.
Dropped! Another one! Floated on middle, Rahim comes down to have a go. Finn runs back from mid off and gets his right hand to it but cannot hold onto it. Another chance goes down for England!
Shakib comes forward and turns it through mid on for a single.
FOUR! And another boundary! Too full outside off, Shakib reaches out for it and clobbers it through extra covers for a boundary.

FOUR! REVERSE SWEEP! Flatter on off, Rahim gets down on this and reverse sweeps it through backward point for a boundary. The runs are starting to flow and England will want to keep a check on them. The lead is 194 runs!
On middle and off, Rahim comes ahead to defend but is hit on his pads. Ali appeals but to no avail.
Rahim comes forward and defends it.
Stays back and turns it towards the on side.
Rahim comes forward and keeps it out.
Floated on middle and leg, Rahim comes down and defends it off his pads.
Shorter outside off, Shakib stays back and cuts it to point.
Turned through square leg for a single.
Too full on middle, Rahim keeps it out towards covers.

NOT OUT! Floated on middle and leg, Rahim comes forward to defend but is hit on his pads. The players appeal but the umpire says no. England go for the review but replays show that pitched outside leg. Was always a desperate review from England, it looked not out to the naked eye as well.
A desperate review from England against Rahim here. It is regarding an LBW appeal.

OUT! How do you drop that? Floated outside off, Shakib goes for the sweep but top edges it to deep mid-wicket. Duckett gets under it but somehow manages to spill it through. That was a sitter really. A single taken.

FOUR! DRILLED! Floated outside off, Shakib gets behind it and drills it through extra cover. Woakes from mid off goes to his right, dives but cannot stop the ball to go through for a boundary. That was just timed to perfection.
Shakib turns it against the spin through mid-wicket for a single.
Shortish delivery outside off, Hasan rocks back and cuts it to cover-point.
Hasan pushes this one towards the cover region.
Quicker one around middle, dug out towards covers.
Full on middle, defended towards mid on.
VICIOUS TURN! On a length, spins away sharply. Hasan defends it uppishly towards gully who is hit on the boots.
DRINKS!
Hasan nudges it behind square and sets off for a single. Stokes throws at the striker's end. Rahim came in casually. The umpires refer it upstairs. The replays show that Rahim was safely in.
Stokes has powered a direct hit at the striker's end. England are not confident, just a tad desperate. The run out decision is referred upstairs.
Driven towards mid off.
On a length, turning in. Rahim clips it through mid-wicket for a single.
Floated up on off, defended off the front foot.
Shakib comes down the track and eases it to long on for a single.
Loopy delivery outside off, turning in. Shakib comes down the track but is beaten and Bairstow fails to collect it. Might have been deceived by the extra bounce. The ball runs down to the fence.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Tossed up on middle, spinning away. Rahim misses to defend but is hit on the pads.
Quicker one on middle, Rahim stays back and defends.
Rahim comes down the track and pushes it to mid on. Wants the single but Shakib sends him back.
Tossed up around off, Rahim comes forward and defends.
MUSHFIQUR RAHIM walks in.

OUT! ALI STRIKES! Flatter delivery just outside off, comes in with the arm. Kayes goes for a full fledged sweep but misses and is rapped on the pads. There is a loud appeal for LBW and the umpire rules it out this time. It looked quite adjacent to the naked eye and Kayes doesn't take the review. The replays confirm that it would have gone on to hit the leg stump. The home side still lead by 176 and are in a strong position.

FOUR! THESE ARE HANDY RUNS FOR BANGLADESH! Tossed up outside off, Shakib kneels to sweep but gets a top edge that flies over the keeper and to the fence. 200 up for the home side and they lead by 176 now!
On a length, spinning into the pads. Hasan stays back and defends it towards leg gully.
Spinning down leg, left alone.
Hasan stays back and defends this one.
Hasan comes down the track but gets hit on the pads and lobs onto his grill and down.
Flighted ball on off, clipped towards short mid-wicket.
Kayes plays this one towards the point region.
Full delivery outside off, defended towards covers.
Similar delivery, Imrul defends off the front foot.
Tossed up on off, Kayes comes forward and defends.
A tad short outside off, Hasan stays back and cuts it towards cover-point for a quick single.
TOTALLY SQUARED HIM UP! Pitches it on leg stump, the ball turns a mile to beat the outside edge of his bat.
Hasan tries to fetch the sweep from outside off but misses and is rapped on the pads. Loud appeal for LBW turned down! The impact was probably outside off.
On the pads, nudged behind square for a single.
Kayes brings out the fancy reverse sweep again. This time the ball comes in with the arm and spins through the batsman. Beats the keeper and runs to the boundary. Four byes signaled by the umpire.
Down the leg side, left alone.
Hasan goes for a full blooded sweep and manages to get it through mid-wicket for a single.
Tossed up outside off, Kayes brings out the reverse sweep and hits it behind point for a single.
Full on off, defended solidly.
A tad short outside off, Kayes stays back and punches it through the covers for a single.
Floated up on off, Kayes lunges forward and blocks.
Pushed to covers for a brisk single.

DROPPED! Pitched on off, Kayes looks to defend on the back foot but is beaten by the away turns and edges it to the right of Root at slip. He dives instinctively but fails to hold onto it. Need to take those in such a close contest! Single taken!
Tossed up nicely on off, spins away a bit. Hasan defends it with an angled bat towards gully.
Full on middle and off, pushed back to the bowler.
Kayes fetches this from outside off and sweeps it through mid-wicket for a single.
On the pads, nudged past leg slip for a single.
This time he stays back and places it in between leg slip and short leg for a single.
Kayes drives it with the spin towards mid on.
Tossed up outside off, spinning in from the rough. Kayes looks to sweep but misses and it goes off his arm to the fielder at leg slip. An appeal for a catch turned down!
On the pads, Hasan misses out on his flick shot as he is rapped on the pads.
Floated up on off, pushed back towards the bowler.
Flighted delivery, Kayes fails to control his sweep and it goes aerially but just falls short of the fielder at deep mid-wicket. Single taken.
Tossed up on the stump, Kayes comes forward and defends.
Just outside off, stays very low. Kayes looks to cut but is completely beaten and it goes through Bairstow to the boundary. Four byes!
Full on middle, blocked.
Hasan comes down the track but Ansari bowls it craftily down the leg side. Shakib fails to get in line but till Bairstow collects it and would have flicked the bails, Shakib came back in.
Sprayed down the leg side, left alone.
Worked towards mid-wicket.
Shakib pulls the shortish delivery behind square for a single.
Down the leg side, spinning further down. Bairstow fails to collect and the ball runs down to the boundary. Four byes signaled by the umpire.
Kayes turns it through square leg for a single.
Kayes drives with the spin wide of mid off for a single.
Shakib pushes it through covers for a single.

CLOSE CALL! Tossed up on off, coming in with the arm. Hasan brings both his bat and pad together in defence. There is an appeal for LBW but in vain. The replays show it may have been pad first and in fact it was hitting the stumps.
Pushed nicely to the cover region.
Outside off, stays low. Shakib somehow manages to defend it towards covers.
THAT'S A JAFFA! Quicker one on off, spins away venomously. Hasan is beaten comprehensively.
The batsman has flicked the ball off his pads. One run added to the total.
On a length on middle, spinning down. Shakib misses his flick and is rapped on the pads. There is an appeal for LBW but turned down.
Shakib clips it hard towards Ballance at short leg who has no time to react and takes it on the body. Can't call that a drop chance!
Tossed up, Hasan camps back and defends it.
Kayes sweeps it down to fine leg for a single.
DROPPED! On the pads, Kayes nudges it towards the right of leg gully. Cook dives low but can't hold onto that. A sharp chance goes down.
Quicker one on off, spins away sharply. Hasan is beaten all ends up.
Outside off, left alone.
Full and quick through the air, coming in with the arm. Hasan looks to clip but gets an inside edge onto his pads. An unnecessary appeal for LBW turned down!
Fullish delivery outside off, Hasan plays it with a thick outside edge towards backward point.
Imrul comes forward and pushes it towards covers for an easy single.
Pitched on a length on off, spins away and bounces sharply. Kayes has no clue about it as he gets beaten while trying to defend.
Going down leg, Shakib has nothing to do with it. 5 runs off the over!
FOUR! TERRIFIC SHOT! Overpitched just outside off, Shakib extends his arms and drills it down the ground. The ball races to the fence.
Hasan leans forward and defends it to short leg.
Around middle and leg, clipped through mid-wicket for a single.
Full on middle, Kayes puts his head down and defends.
Kayes drives against the spin towards mid off.
GOOD BALL! Very full on off, Hasan digs it out in the nick of time.
On the pads, tucked towards the leg side.
Loopy delivery around off, Hasan is solid in his defence.
Tossed up at the stumps, Shakib prods forward in defence.
Coming in with the arm, Shakib looks to clip it square but gets a leading edge towards the off side.
Hasan stays back and defends solidly.
Hasan tucks it into the leg side to get off the mark!
Similar delivery, Shakib looks to defend but misses and the ball hits his pads and lobs to short leg who catches it. Muted appeal for caught behind turned down.
On a length, spinning towards leg. Hasan camps back and defends towards short leg.
Full on leg stump, driven towards short mid-wicket.
Around leg stump, nudged through square leg for a single.
Full on middle and leg, Kayes comes forward and defends down the pitch.
ZAFAR ANSARI to bowl from the other end.
On the pads, nudged round the corner for a single.
Kayes prods forward to the flighted delivery and defends it.
FOUR! STREAKY RUNS! On a length around off, spinning sharply. Kayes goes for the cut but gets a top edge over the slip region and the ball runs to the third man boundary.
Kayes camps back and defends it.
Pitched around off, spins away viciously. Kayes is beaten. Bairstow flicks the ball in a jiffy and appeals. Dharmasena thinks about referring but doesn't do so.
Starts from around the wicket. Nicely tossed up on off, Kayes prods forward and pushes it gently to short cover.
Game time! The players are out in the middle. IMRUL KAYES joined by the new man SHAKIB AL HASAN at the crease. MOEEN ALI to bowl the first over of the day. Here we go...

England will be disappointed with the fact that they could not trigger a collapse to keep the hosts in check. In the first innings, the hosts lost 9 for 49 and England will want to trigger another such collapse since batting last on this wicket, chasing any substantial score could prove to be a herculean task.

Hello everyone and welcome to the coverage of the Day 3 of the second and final Test between Bangladesh and England from Shere Bangla National Stadium, Mirpur.  The hosts are in front with a lead of 128 runs and have seven wickets in hand. With the pitch assisting spinners and the ball starting to misbehave more, they will know anything over 250 will give them a real chance at levelling the series 1-1.
...DAY 3...SESSION 1...

Bangladesh lead by 128 now and the odd delivery is turning sharply. They have the ball in their court and will look to press on the advantage. England are on the back foot and it would be interesting to see how they fight back! We hope you enjoyed our coverage today! Join us for all the action on day 3 tomorrow. Till then, goodbye and take care!

Earlier in the day, Bangladesh bowled really well to have England reeling at 69 for 5 but a steady knock from Joe Root and the 99-run partnership between Woakes and Rashid turned the tide in favour of the visitors as they got a 24-run lead. Mehedi Hasan stole the limelight as he spun his magic around the Englishmen to take 6 wickets.

A good comeback by Bangladesh in the final session. They have scored at a really good pace notching up 152 on the board in 31 overs. Iqbal began aggressively with good support from Kayes as they stitched a 50-run partnership. Iqbal fell against the run of play and Haque departed quickly after that too. Mahmudullah played well but threw his wicket on what turned out to be the last ball of the day.

OUT! What a bad shot at the stroke of stumps! Mahmudullah has thrown his wicket away! Pitched fullish on middle, Mahmudullah goes for a full blooded sweep but misses the line completely as the ball turns a bit. The ball crashes into the off stump. A long walk back for Mahmudullah. England have got a freebie here. With that, it's STUMPS ON DAY 2!
Full on off, Mahmudullah puts his head down and defends.
Kayes kneels and sweeps it down to fine leg for a single.
Outside off, left alone by Kayes.
Kayes comes down the track to defend but is struck on the pads.
Tossed up around off, pushed to mid off for a single.
ZAFAR ANSARI will have a bowl.
A tad short outside off, punched towards covers.
Kayes offers a straight bat in defence.
Much fuller this time and spins away viciously to beat the outside edge.
Pitched around off, spins awaty. Kayes prods forward and leaves it alone.
Full delivery, eased down to long on for a single.
Mahmudullah tucks it nicely through square leg for a couple.
MOEEN ALI comes onto bowl.
Pitched outside leg, turning in. Kayes  attempts the reverse sweep but is hit on the pads.
FOUR! SHOT! Kayes fetches this from outside off and sweeps it nicely in front of square for a boundary.
Kayes kneels and sweeps it nicely behind square for a couple.
That one turned and bounced sharply! On a length outside off, spins in sharply. Kayes is surprised and gets an edge towards short third man.
Full on leg stump, Mahmudullah sweeps it down to fine leg for a single.
Tossed up on leg stump, nudged towards mid-wicket for a single. There is a throw at the bowler's end but is off target. Concedes an overthrow in the process.
Full on middle, Kayes gets his head down and defends.
Mahmudullah makes room and drives it towards covers.
On middle and leg, nudged through mid-wicket for a single.
Outside off, spins away. Kayes misses out on his sweep shot.
Kayes drives it with the spin through mid off for a single.
Mahmudullah prods forward and eases it to long on for a single.
Outside off, left alone.
4th Test fifty for IMRUL KAYES.
FOUR! Outside off, Kayes reverse sweeps and the ball runs down to the fine leg boundary. 50 up for Kayes and it has been a crucial knock. Would like to carry on!
Mahmudullah pulls it through mid-wicket for a single.
Kayes pushes it wide of mid off for a single.
Drags his length back a bit, Mahmudullah camps back and punches it down the ground foe a single.
Mahmudullah prods forward and defends solidly.
Comes down the track and eases it to long on for a single.
Around off, going in with the arm. Mahmudullah is beaten on his defence.
Spinning down leg, nudged past leg slip for a couple.
Pitched around off, spinning in. Mahmudullah prods to defend but misses and is rapped on the pads. Muted appeal for LBW turned down. It would have gone down leg.
On the pads, swept behind square for a single.
Full on middle, Kayes makes room and drives it towards the covers. Bairstow appeals loudly for some reason. Kayes turns back and looks at him in surprise.
MOEEN ALI comes back to bowl.
Tossed up around off, spins away sharply, left alone.
Mahmudullah stays back and defends it.
Kayes kneels and sweeps it to backward square leg for a single.
The floodlights are switched on.
Shortish delivery, going down leg. Hits Kayes on the thigh pad.
A tad short outside off, punched towards point for a single.
Full on middle, Mahmudullah drives it back towards the bowler.
Defended off the back foot by the batsman.
FOUR! Lovely shot! Full outside off, Kayes comes forward and drives it through covers for an exquisite boundary.
Mahmudullah drives it towards mid on for a single.
New bat coming in for Mahmudullah.
On a length outside off, played towards point.
Back of a length ball on off, defended off the back foot.
FOUR! 50-run partnership up for Kayes and Mahmudullah. On the pads, Mahmudullah tickles it very fine and the ball races to the boundary.
FOUR! SHOT! A tad short, Kayes rocks back and pulls it through mid-wicket for a boundary.
Kayes comes down and hits the full toss uppishly and the ball falls just short of Stokes at short mid-wicket.
Kayes comes forward and gets an edge past slip. Two runs taken.
Tossed up on off, Kayes brings out the reverse sweep and hits it behind point. Ansari covers  good ground in the deep and keeps it down to two.
Drags his length back, this time Mahmudullah turns it wide of mid on for a single.
Full on off, Mahmudullah prods forward and defends.
FOUR! THAT'S A FABULOUS STROKE! Back of a length ball on off, Kayes stands tall and pulls it powerfully through mid-wicket and the ball races to the fence.
On a good length, angling away. Imrul watches it closely and lets it through.
Pitched on a length around off, nips away. Kayes looks to defend but is beaten all ends up.
Very full delivery outside off, Imrul looks to place it through the covers but misses. There is a stifled appeal for caught behind but there wasn't anything on that one.
Full ball on middle, defended towards the leg side.
Mahmudullah goes across and clips it towards mid-wicket for a single.
CHRIS WOAKES comes into the attack.
Kayes plays a sweep uppishly down to fine leg. Luckily, there is no one in the deep. Two runs taken!
Full delivery, Kayes does well to dig it out.
Pitched outside leg, holds its line. Left alone by Kayes.
Short on off, spins away. Mahmudullah stays back and punches it to mid on for a single.
Very wide outside off, spins away further. Bairstow dives to his right to collect it.
On a length outside off, defended off the back foot towards the off side.
ADIL RASHID comes to bowl.
WELL BOWLED! Full length ball just outside off, Kayes looks to defend it but the ball takes an inside edge and hits the back pad.
On the pads, clipped towards mid-wicket for a single.
Full length ball outside off, driven nicely towards covers.
In between full and good length outside off, Mahmudullah stays back and defends.
On a length outside off, Mahmudullah stays back and defends solidly.
On middle and leg, clipped behind square for a single.
A tad short outside off, punched nicely to covers but fails to find the gap.
Mahmudullah stays back and pushes it towards short cover.
Short outside off, punched towards the covers.
Mahmudullah plays against the spin towards mid-wicket for a single. There is a wayward throw and the batsmen get an overthrow in the process.
Kayes sweeps this uppishly over mid-wicket and Ali who is stationed at the boundary misjudges it but he wouldn't have reached it anyways. Couple taken.
Mahmudullah comes down to the loopy delivery and eases it down to long on for a single.
There's some rain in the air!
On the pads, picked through square leg for a couple.
Shortish delivery outside off, cut towards point.
On a length angling into middle. Nudged through square leg for a single.
Short delivery outside off, Mahmudullah pulls it uppishly towards short mid-wicket but falls just in front of the fielder. There is some chit chat going on between Stokes and Mahmudullah.
Fuller length ball outside off, Kayes is not in control as he plays it uppishly through gully for a single.
Wide! Dug in very short outside off, zips through the pitch. Kayes looked to play at it but it was way above his head and he lets  it go. Wide signaled for height!
Full ball on off, Imrul puts his head down and defends.
TIME FOR DRINKS!
Tossed up on a length around off, Mahmudullah stays back and defends it to the off side.
FOUR! SHOT! Tossed up on middle, Mahmudullah lifts it over mid on and the ball races to the fence.
Tossed up on off, Mahmudullah offers a straight bat in defence.
Very full outside off, pushed towards the cover region.
On a length, spinning away sharply. Mahmudullah looks to cut it but only gets it from the inner half of his bat down the pitch.
Full outside off, driven towards the covers.
Fullish ball around off, Kayes looks to defend but gets an inside edge that rolls towards the leg side.
Short of a length ball on off, Kayes covers the line and defends it solidly.
Full length delivery outside off, Kayes strides forward and defends.
Good length delivery outside off, defended towards covers.
Straight and on a length this time, Kayes camps back and defends down the pitch.
Good delivery! On a good length outside off, Imrul prods forward to defend but is beaten comprehensively.
FOUR! Crafty shot! Mahmudullah kneels and sweeps it down to fine leg for a boundary.
THAT'S A JAFFA! On middle, spins away viciously. Mahmudullah looks to defend but is beaten all ends up!
Tossed up, driven sweetly to the covers.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
On the pads, nudged round the corner for a couple.
Mahmudullah strides forward and pushes back towards the bowler.
Fullish ball outside off, left alone.
Short on middle, Mahmudullah pulls it through square leg for a single.
FOUR! Back-to-Back boundaries! Full outside off, Mahmudullah leans forward and creams it through the covers for a superb boundary.
FOUR! SHOT! Shortish delivery, Mahmudullah pulls it nicely through square leg for a boundary.
Switches angles and bowls a length delivery at the stumps, Mahmudullah covers the line and defends.
MAHMUDULLAH is the new batsman.

OUT! Another wicket falls in a jiffy! Comes around the wicket and bowls a back of a length ball, angling into Haque from outside off. He is cramped up a bit as he gets an outside edge and Cook grabs it safely in the slip region. England are delighted!
Haque drives it through the covers for a single.
MOMINUL HAQUE comes in at 3.

OUT! Well bowled and he gets his first Test wicket! Bowls a loopy ball on leg stump, Iqbal looks to nudge it round the corner but only gets an edge towards leg slip. Cook makes no mistake and grabs a good catch. The man in form departs!
Outside leg, clipped towards mid-wicket.
On the stumps, Iqbal comes forward and blocks.
Pitched outside leg, Iqbal pads it away.
Full on middle, clipped towards wide of mid on where the fielder dives to make a good save.
LOOSE SHOT! On a length outside off, angling away, Kayes throws his bat at it and gets beaten
No ball! Fullish delivery wide outside off, Tamim plays a free flowing drive to sweeper cover for a single. Stokes overstepped on that occasion.
On a length outside off, Iqbal lets it through.
Dug in short on middle, Imrul swivels across and pullls it through mid-wicket for a single.
Fuller delivery wide outside off, Kayes doesn't flirt with that one.
On a good length angling across Kayes. He points his bat skywards and lets it through.
On a length around leg stump, Tamim goes back and works it through mid-wicket for a single.
BEN STOKES introduced into the attack.
Straying on the pads, nudged round the corner for a single.
Iqbal plays it this one and does well to keep it down towards short leg.
Going down leg, Iqbal lets it go. The English side is trying to catch him round the corner.
Pitched on leg, spinning down. Left alone by Tamim.
FOUR! NICELY DONE! Loopy ball, Iqbal brings out the fancy reverse sweep and the ball races to the third man boundary.
Tamim steps down the track and blocks it.
Quicker one on middle and off, Iqbal gets an inside edge onto his pads.
FOUR! THIS IS VINTAGE TAMIM! He comes down to a loopy delivery and plays it inside out over the covers. The fielder in the deep can only watch as the ball goes through to the boundary in a jiffy.
Almost a replica of the previous delivery!
Iqbal puts his head down and defends in the direction of the bowler.
On a length around off, spinning away. Kayes goes back and punches it through cover-point for a single.
FOUR! STREAKY RUNS FOR KAYES! Outside off, Kayes gets an outside edge that goes in between slip and gully and through to the boundary.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
FOUR! THIS IS GOOD BATTING FROM TAMIM! Tossed up on off, Iqbal brings out the reverse sweep and nails it perfectly behind point. The ball races to the fence.
Iqbal comes down the track and defends it back to the bowler.
Iqbal comes down and works it towards mid-wicket.
Pitched outside leg, swept to fine leg for a single.
Loopy ball, Kayes presses forward and defends in the direction of the bowler.
Iqbal camps back and plays it towards point.
Kayes plays it against the spin through mid-wicket for a single.
FOUR! Lovely shot! Tossed up on middle, Kayes sweeps it uppishly through square leg for a boundary. There were shouts of catch it but there was no fielder in near sight.
THAT'S A JAFFA! On a length on off, turns away sharply. Kayes is beaten all ends up on his defence.
Full outside off, defended with an angled blade towards point.
Iqbal pushes it with the spin through mid off for a single.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Tamim comes down the track and eases it through mid on for a single.
On the pads, Iqbal tucks it towards Cook at leg slip who dives to grab it but isn't able to do so. The replays show it just kisses his fingertips. Difficult to hold on to those!
Iqbal drives this one back towards the bowler.
FOUR! LOOSE DELIVERY AND IT GETS THE TREATMENT! Too full and wide outside off, Iqbal drives it nicely through the covers for a boundary.
Bowls it fullish on leg stump, nudged uppishly wide of leg slip for a single.
ZAFAR ANSARI comes onto bowl.
Kayes drives it with the spin down to long off for a single.
Full and slow on middle and off, Kayes prods forward to defend but gets an inside edge onto his pads.
A tad short around off, punched towards covers.
Kayes gets his head down and defends back towards the bowler.
Pitched on a length on off, turned away sharply. Kayes is beaten on the back foot.
FOUR! SHOT! On the pads, Kayes sweeps it towards fine leg and the ball races to the boundary.
Short ball that is well directed on middle and off, Iqbal sways away from the line and leaves it.
FOUR! Beautiful from Tamim! Overpitched outside off, Iqbal prods forward and creams it through the covers for an exquisite boundary.

Fullish delivery angling in. Imrul is tentative in his footwork as he looks to clip it square but misses and is rapped on the thigh pad. There is a loud appeal but in vain. It is really difficult to get an LBW from this angle. Leg bye taken.
Angling on the pads, clipped through mid-wicket for a single.
Angling into middle and leg, Iqbal fails to clip it and is rapped on the pads.
Comes around the wicket and bowls it on a length outside off, angling in. Tamim looks to drive but gets an inside edge onto his pads.
Tossed up and full outside off, Imrul presses forward and defends.
Kayes waits for this one and plays it towards point.
A tad short outside off, punched through covers for a single.
Sprayed down the leg side, Iqbal looks to clip but misses.
Going down leg, Kayes misses his flick and the keeper fails to collect it. The ball runs down to short fine leg. Bye taken!
On off, holds its line. Kayes get a slight edge that falls short of first slip.
Got his line wrong again. On the pads, flicked to deep backward square leg for a couple.
Going down leg, Iqbal shuffles across but decides to leave it.
FOUR! GOOD SHOT! On the pads, Iqbal just clips it nicely through mid-wicket and the ball races to the fence.
Straying on the pads, nudged to deep square leg for a single.
On a length going down leg, Kayes leaves it alone.
Short of a length on middle, Kayes stays back and defends towards the off side.

A LOUD SHOUT FOR LBW TURNED DOWN! Pitches it around off, coming in with the arm. Iqbal prods forward to defend but misses and is rapped on the pads. The umpire shakes his head after a long thought. The replays show that the impact was outside off.
A tad short around off, Iqbal camps back and punches it back towards the bowler.
Flighted delivery, Iqbal presses forward and blocks.
Kayes drives it with the spin through mid off for a single.
THAT'S A RIPPER! Tossed up on a length on off, spins away sharply. Kayes is beaten!
Full around middle and leg, clipped towards short mid-wicket for a single.
MOEEN ALI to share the new cherry from the other end.
On the pads, Tamim fails to clip it as the ball rolls towards square leg off his pads. Leg bye taken.
FOUR! That's crashed! Short and outside off, Iqbal slashes it uppishly through cover-point and the ball races to the fence.
On a good length on off, shaping in a bit. Tamim is tentative as he pushes on his front foot and gets an inside edge onto his pads.
Dug in short around leg stump, Kayes is caught in the crease as he fends it towards square leg.
On the pads, Tamim flicks it down to fine leg for a single. Gets off the mark!
In between full and good length on off, Iqbal prods forward and defends.
